primary_line.question: Does free-form persistent-state synthesis create a reproducibility and utility bottleneck under matched trajectory evidence?
primary_line.working_title: Same Evidence, Different Skill: Diagnosing State-Generation Variance in Self-Evolving Agents

novelty_boundaries.skillrevise_collision: trace-conditioned structured diagnosis, repair-principle retrieval, and execution-anchored skill revision are prior work and are not claimed as E2-R17 novelty
novelty_boundaries.wikiskill_collision: separating raw traces, persistent knowledge, and skills / compiling experience into persistent knowledge is prior work and is not claimed as E2-R17 novelty
novelty_boundaries.rethinking_collision: feedback-dependent skill evolution and usefulness of failed trajectories are prior observations and are not claimed as E2-R17 novelty
novelty_boundaries.residual_novelty_target: independently identifying state-generation realization variance under matched evidence and prospectively factorizing evidence source x complete state-generation method

experiment_ladder: M3 exactly two frozen-state stability remeasurements if M2 passes
M4 prospective Winner vs First-Fail-4 x Free-form vs Constrained-Compiler bridge
M5 separate untouched E3 confirmation only after M4 passes
